title: Billing Terms for Storage Unit Periods Drafted under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization: Moving-Out Periods and the Military Discount
content:
**Term.** For a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement drafted under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, the unit notice amount charges for each of its two due dates, the noticed due date and the in-flight draft's due date, the following:

- **nothing**, where the agreement is moving out and its planned vacate date is on or before that due date, because that period is not charged;
- **the rent in force less the unit class's military discount rate, rounded to the cent**, where the military discount is applied on the agreement;
- **otherwise, the rent in force as it stands.**

The tiers are read in that order: a moving-out agreement whose planned vacate date is on or before the due date is not charged for that period whether or not the military discount is applied. The discounted figure is the rent in force times one minus the military discount rate, rounded to the cent.

**Records read.** The Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement's status (moving out), its planned vacate date, whether the military discount is applied, and its unit class.

| Unit class of the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement | Military discount rate |
|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | 10% |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | 10% |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | 10% |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | 10% |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | 10% |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | 0% |

### Truth table for one due date

| Agreement moving out | Planned vacate date on or before the due date | Military discount applied | Charge for that period |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes or No | Nothing |
| Yes | No, or no vacate date | Yes | Rent in force less the discount, rounded to the cent |
| Yes | No, or no vacate date | No | Rent in force |
| No | — | Yes | Rent in force less the discount, rounded to the cent |
| No | — | No | Rent in force |

### Worked cases (hypothetical rents and dates)

- Rent in force $187.50, military discount applied on a Bluegate Climate Controlled unit (10%): $187.50 times 0.90 is $168.75.
- Rent in force $129.99, same class and discount: $129.99 times 0.90 is $116.991, rounded to $116.99.
- Military discount applied on a Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault (0%): the period is charged at the rent in force.
- Planned vacate date 30 June; due dates 15 June and 15 July. The agreement is moving out: the 15 June period is charged; the 15 July period, on or after the vacate date, is charged nothing. A planned vacate date equal to the due date also leaves that period uncharged.
